# VRCast

> VRCast is a free, open-source (Apache License 2.0) Windows app that shows a VRChat 3D avatar on its own and sends it to OBS, Discord and Zoom without opening Unity or VRChat. 日本語: VRChat のアバターを、Unity・VRChat を開かずにそのまま配信へ。

The avatar is exported once from the Unity project that contains it (Unity 2022.3.22f1, VCC projects are fine) to a `.vrcaster` file. After that, VRCast.exe loads the file by drag and drop; Unity, VCC and VRChat do not need to run. VRCast is not an official VRChat Inc. tool.

VRM avatars (`.vrm`, VRM 0.x / 1.0, e.g. made with VRoid Studio) load directly without exporting; their expressions, blink, A-I-U-E-O mouth shapes and spring bones are used.

Key facts:

- Platform: Windows 10 / 11 (x64). Price: free.
- Output: transparent background for OBS Game Capture ("Allow Transparency"), and the "VRCast Camera" virtual camera for Discord, Zoom and similar apps.
- Tracking: bundled MediaPipe tracker for head, blink, mouth, gaze, arms, hands and fingers, plus facial expressions (smile, surprise, anger, sadness); OpenSeeFace is also supported. A webcam is optional.
- Idle motion: breathing, body sway and slight head motion in the Pose tab while a webcam is not driving the avatar (on by default for Humanoid avatars; head motion pauses during face tracking).
- Face: A-I-U-E-O lip sync from the microphone and auto blink.
- Keeps the VRChat setup: expressions, default toggles, PhysBones (approximated) and constraints. The original avatar is not modified.
- UI languages: Japanese, English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.
- The avatar shown in the screenshots is "Marycia マリシア" by BeroarN (https://brn.booth.pm/items/6305948), not part of VRCast.
